free-api

Your own gateway: issue free API keys and call anthracite-org/magnum-v4-72b from any website via an OpenAI-compatible URL.

checking /health…

1. Create a free gateway key (needs admin token)

(key will appear here)

2. Test chat (uses your gateway key)

(reply will appear here)

3. Use in your website

Base URL: /v1

const BASE = location.origin + "/v1"; // or http://localhost:8787/v1
const KEY = "sk-free-PASTE-YOURS";

const r = await fetch(BASE + "/chat/completions", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "content-type": "application/json", "authorization": "Bearer " + KEY },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    model: "anthracite-org/magnum-v4-72b",
    messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Hello!" }]
  })
});
const data = await r.json();
console.log(data.choices[0].message.content);

Honest note: gateway keys/URL are free & unlimited. The model itself costs money on hosted providers (e.g. OpenRouter ~$2.50/$5 per 1M tokens) unless you run it locally with Ollama. Without an upstream key this server returns a clearly-labeled MOCK so you can build for free.
